Hi Alice — great to meet earlier. Thanks for the time and for outlining FinTechCorp's security review needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: customer-facing payouts workflow, low-latency inference, PII minimization.
- Key controls you asked about: SOC 2 status, incident response & breach notification timelines, BCP/DR evidence, and vendor security questionnaire completion.

Action items / next steps:
1) Ben: share our standard vendor security questionnaire (attached) and a short SOC 2 summary.
2) Jordan (cc): follow up with technical BCP/DR artifacts and runbook items; we may need Marissa for evidence exports.
3) Alice / FinTechCorp: confirm timeline and any NDA/secure upload for SOC 2 report.

Can you confirm whether you prefer the completed questionnaire returned via email or uploaded to your secure portal? Also please confirm the required timeline for breach notification details (e.g., internal review vs external/regulatory notification). Happy to schedule a 30-min follow-up this week.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_FinTechCorp.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Ben
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintechcorp.com; procurement@fintechcorp.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + request for vendor questionnaire and SOC 2

Hi Ben — thanks for the recap. Upload to our secure portal is preferred (we'll share the link), but email is OK for initial screening. A few clarifications before you send anything: 

- SOC 2: is there a Type II report available now, or an in-progress engagement? If in-progress, what is the expected completion date?
- Incident response: we need to confirm notification timelines for customers and regulators. For GDPR-related incidents we require customer notification details within 72 hours of detection; for HIPAA covered data, we expect notification steps and timelines (HHS/affected parties). Can you confirm Redwood's commitments?
- BCP/DR evidence: we need business continuity plan excerpts, DR RTO/RPO numbers for the inference service, and evidence of recent DR tests.

I'll share the secure upload link in a follow-up email. For now, please populate the questionnaire and include any SOC 2 summary you can share without an NDA.

Thanks,
Alice Johnson
Security Program Manager, FinTechCorp
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + request for vendor questionnaire and SOC 2

Thanks Alice — attaching the questionnaire with initial answers and a short SOC 2 summary (public-safe).

High level answers to your specific asks: 
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II engagement. Our most recent Type II report is available under NDA; attached is a one-page summary (SOC2_summary.pdf). If you need the full report, we can provide it after an NDA or via your secure portal.
- Incident response & notification:
  - Detection & internal escalation: incidents are triaged by our IR team immediately upon detection.
  - Customer notification: customers are notified of confirmed incidents that impact customer data or service availability as soon as reasonably possible; for incidents with potential regulator reporting (e.g., GDPR), we provide timelines and root-cause information aligned with regulator requirements.
  - GDPR: we follow a <72-hour regulatory notification window for incidents that meet GDPR breach criteria and will provide evidence of investigation and notification steps.
  - HIPAA: for incidents involving PHI, Redwood follows HIPAA notification requirements; we work with customers on notification timing and content as required.
  - We aim to provide initial customer-facing incident summaries within 24 hours of confirmation when feasible; full remediation reports follow the internal investigation cadence.
- BCP/DR: our BCP contains RTO/RPO targets for platform services; Marissa will attach DR test artifacts and a DR runbook excerpt.

Attachments in this email (stubs): Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_FinTechCorp.xlsx (completed - partial), SOC2_summary.pdf, Redwood_Incident_Response_SLA.docx

If you confirm the secure upload link, we'll move the full SOC 2 under NDA there and drop the larger BCP/DR artifacts into the secure location as well. Would you be available for a 30-min follow-up Thursday to walk through the IR timelines and any redlines to the questionnaire?

Best,
Ben
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prepare BCP/DR evidence for FinTechCorp

Ben — looping Marissa as discussed. I'll need the following artifacts to include in the secure bundle:
- DR runbook excerpt (network failover steps, dependency map)
- Most recent DR test summary and date
- RTO/RPO values for the inference service and any service isolation notes (hosted vs dedicated)
- Evidence of last tabletop exercise (slides/notes)

Marissa — can you pull the DR test logs and package a zip (BCP_DR_Evidence.zip) with redacted logs and test summaries? If any items require legal/NDAs, note them and we'll route through procurement. Target to have the package ready by EOD today for Ben to upload to FinTechCorp's portal tomorrow.

Thanks — Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechcorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: BCP/DR evidence + SOC2 next steps (FinTechCorp)

Hi Alice — thanks and appreciate the fast turnaround on the portal link. We've packaged the initial evidence for FinTechCorp's review: 

Package contents (attached as stubs):
- BCP_DR_Evidence.zip: DR test summaries, redacted logs, runbook excerpt (PDFs inside).
- SOC2_summary.pdf: one-page summary of controls and engagement window. Full Type II report available via NDA/secure upload.
- Signed_SLA_Draft.pdf: copy of the proposed SLA language (putting timelines and notification obligations in writing).

A few notes on notification timelines and evidence: 
- We notify customers of confirmed incidents that impact customer data or production availability as soon as possible; for incidents meeting GDPR breach criteria we provide regulator-facing details within 72 hours from confirmation of breach scope.
- Our internal IR process includes containment, eradication, root-cause analysis, and remediation verification; remediation timelines vary by incident severity.
- BCP/DR: current RTO for our hosted inference control plane is 4 hours for control-plane failover (this is for the managed/hosted tier; Dedicated customers can request different targets under contract), and RPO is <15 minutes for session/kv-cache persistence across active regions where configured.

If you need further artifacts (full SOC 2 Type II, raw test logs under NDA, architecture-level dependency maps), we can provide via your secure portal once the NDA is in place. Would you like to schedule the 30-min call tomorrow to walk through any redlines?

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
